result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall, but there is one clear visual defect: the metadata line under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has two text elements drawn on top of each other, which makes the delivery time and fee unreadable.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata row under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' has overlapping text. The delivery time ('25–35 min') and the delivery fee ('€0 delivery') are drawn on top of each other, producing garbled text like '25–3€0mdelivery' before the '• Ramen' label. Neither value can be read.
issues.suggestion: Lay the metadata items out in a single row with proper spacing and separators (e.g. '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'). Check for absolute positioning, negative margins, or a missing flex gap or separator that lets the fee label collapse onto the time label.
